heroHeadline: Ceuta Clears Beach Camp as Rights Groups Warn of Legal Vacuum
heroSubtitle: Police relocate over 1,200 migrants from the El Trampolín beach camp to new shelters as Human Rights Watch decries weeks without adequate sanitation; Morocco disperses a 294-person regrouping attempt near Fnideq while Spain plans a mainland transfer of 500 unaccompanied girls over EU objections.
